svg.title: AI hardware mentor engine — two-mode system architecture
svg.desc: Standard system architecture showing three inputs (experiment/lab spec, live visual/camera, control board IDE environment) feeding into the AI mentor engine in Mode 1 (mentoring/teaching), which produces suggestions and corrections, then transitions to Mode 2 (training/challenge mode) where the AI becomes a question engine and the learner responds by changing code or mechanical components to achieve a target output.

g.text: AI hardware mentor engine — system architecture
